envelope.description: Wire the file store into the extension

body.title: Wire the file store into the extension
body.summary: In extension.ts run migrateChatSessionsFromMemento over context.globalState first, build chatStore with createFileChatSessionStore over join(PATHS.insrc, 'chat-sessions') with the same maxSessions and onEvict, and give the output sweep a keep set of the store's ids plus the migration's kept ids. Update extension-chat-wiring.test.ts: replace the line-46 assertion with ones for the file store, its root and the migration placed before it; keep the onEvict assertion; change the sweep assertion to the new keep set.
acceptanceChecks: extension.ts calls the migration before it builds the file store over join(PATHS.insrc, 'chat-sessions') with the session cap and the onEvict
The sweep's keep set holds the store's ids and the migration's kept ids
createMementoChatSessionStore is no longer constructed in extension.ts
The plugin type-checks and the wiring test passes with the updated assertions

tests.name: extension.ts runs the migration before it builds the file store over join(PATHS.insrc, 'chat-sessions') with the session cap and the onEvict, and the output sweep keeps the store's ids and the migration's kept ids
